query:
UPDATE waste_bins SET
                number = $2,
                latitude = $3,
                longitude = $4,
                geometry = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($4, $3), 4326),
                volume_liters = $5,
                depth_cm = $6,
                organization_id = $7,
                provider = $8,
                additional_informations = $9,
                fill_fraction = $10,
                fill_measured_at = $11,
                last_emptied_at = $12
            WHERE id = $1
